dashboard_grid.description: Split screen vertically into two 50% width scrollable columns (or a 2-column FlatList). Left: CRYPTO, Right: SAHAM.

Header.description: Sticky top bar with App Name 'AITrade Pro', Theme Toggle (Sun/Moon), Settings/Manage Assets Icon.

TimeframeSelector.active_state: Solid background matching surfaceHighlight, border bottom accentUp or brand color.

DashboardList.description: Two parallel columns. Due to screen width constraints, use dense rows inside each column.

CardItem.layout: Row based or dense vertical. Ticker top-left, Price bottom-left, Signal top-right, Confidence bottom-right.
CardItem.Signal_BUY: Text color accentUp, bg color accentUp with 20% opacity.
CardItem.Signal_SELL: Text color accentDown, bg color accentDown with 20% opacity.
CardItem.Signal_HOLD: Text color accentHold, bg color accentHold with 20% opacity.

ManageAssetsModal.description: Screen/Modal to add/remove assets from the active screening list.

DetailScreen.description: Asset details with big candlestick/line chart, Technical Indicators, AI textual analysis (Claude/GPT mock), Entry/Exit/SL/TP points, and News/Global Data impact reports.
DetailScreen.Chart: Use react-native-chart-kit, react-native-svg, or react-native-wagmi-charts for rendering.

testing.attributes: Add testID prop to all interactive elements in React Native (e.g., testID='crypto-btc-card').

trading_chart_bg.description: stock market candlestick chart on dark screen
trading_chart_bg.usage: Background image for the AI Analysis / News report header on Detail screen.

colorful_data_screen.description: Detailed financial trading screen with colorful charts
colorful_data_screen.usage: Background placeholder for global news/reports section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build an Expo React Native application using .js files (NOT .tsx).
Implement a Dark/Light theme context, defaulting to Dark Mode (Pro Exchange). No login required.
On the Home Screen, place a Timeframe Selector horizontally at the top (15m, 30m, 60m, 3h, 6h, 12h, 18h, 24h).
Below the selector, display a 2-column layout side-by-side (Left: CRYPTO, Right: SAHAM) showing asset cards. Use dense mobile UI.
Data to mock/display: CRYPTO (BTC, ETH, HYPE, USDT, ASTER, BNB, XRP, SOL, DOGE, PEPE, SUI, ADA, TRX, LTC, LINK, HBAR, SHIB, DOT, BCH, SAND, ALGO, XAUT).
Data to mock/display: SAHAM (BBCA, BBRI, BMRI, TPIA, ADRO, DEWA, ASII, EMTK, ADMR, BRMS, PANI, CBRE, RAJA, PTRO, INET, ANTM, MBMA, MDKA).
Mock AI signals containing BUY/SELL/HOLD/LONG/SHORT and a confidence percentage (e.g., 92%) for each asset.
Create a Details screen when tapping an asset, featuring an interactive chart, detailed AI analysis (mocked from Claude/GPT), Entry/Exit points, and News impact.
Implement an Add/Remove Asset screen accessible from the dashboard.
Add 'testID' attributes to all Touchable and interactive components.
